business_summary: Rix Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of machinery and equipment, measuring instruments, and consumables for steel, automobiles, electronics, semiconductors, rubber and tires, machine tools, environment, pulp and paper, ship building, medicine, high-function materials, and food industries in Japan. It provides rotary; rocky insulator; Nitte lights; lubricants under FRICTTLE name; hardlock nuts, bearing nuts, and set screw; and oil seals, O-rings, iron rubbers, mechanical seals, welded bellows, flexible circuits, etc. It also offers Auto Flush, a system that reduces leakage; oil skimmers; and vivid screen. In addition, the company engages in the construction, manufacturing, and sale of pipes and steel structures, as well as bearing regeneration, new bearing and part manufacturing, precision grinding, polishing, universal joint repair, and related equipment sales; manufacture, sale, and maintenance of automobile parts cleaning equipment and other industrial machinery; import and sale of anti-rust agents, moisture inhibitors, and adhesives; and coolant automatic dilution device manufacturing, electrical and control software design, control panel manufacturing and wiring work, and robot control. Further, it provides phenolic resin molded products; FRP corrosion-resistant pumps, fans, dampers, strainers, and scrubbers; washing machines for automobile parts and semiconductor; and jigs and tools, FPD manufacturing equipment, electronic and optical component manufacturing equipment, consumable parts, dry vacuum pumps, air compressors, valves for tire curing presses, tire manufacturing equipment, and hydraulic equipment. Additionally, the company is involved in the sale and repair of vacuum equipment; maintenance and management services for semiconductor manufacturing equipment; and design, manufacture, assembly, and maintenance of processed products and overhaul of machine tools. Rix Corporation was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Rix Corporation은 일본 내 철강, 자동차, 전자, 반도체, 고무 및 타이어, 공작기계, 환경, 펄프 및 제지, 조선, 의약품, 고기능 소재, 식품 산업에 사용되는 기계 및 장비, 계측기, 소모품을 제조 및 판매하는 회사입니다. 회전식을 제공합니다. 암석 절연체; 니트 조명; FRICTTLE 이름의 윤활제; 하드락 너트, 베어링 너트 및 고정 나사; 오일 씰, O-링, 철 고무, 기계적 씰, 용접 벨로우즈, 연성 회로 등이 있습니다. 또한 누출을 줄이는 시스템인 Auto Flush도 제공합니다. 오일 스키머; 그리고 생생한 화면. 또한, 회사는 파이프 및 철 구조물의 건설, 제조 및 판매뿐만 아니라 베어링 재생, 새로운 베어링 및 부품 제조, 정밀 연삭, 연마, 유니버셜 조인트 수리 및 관련 장비 판매에도 종사하고 있습니다. 자동차 부품 세척 장비 및 기타 산업 기계의 제조, 판매 및 유지 관리; 방청제, 습기억제제, 접착제 등의 수입 및 판매; 및 냉각수 자동희석장치 제작, 전기 및 제어 소프트웨어 설계, 제어반 제작 및 배선
